jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(1)(E) inventory: Milton Supervisory District -- the Milton School District (a town district) is its own supervisory district (member town: Milton). Operates PK-12.

sources.note: Milton School District: five School Trustees at-large under 16 V.S.A. section 423(a)-(b) -- three 3-year seats plus the two additional seats the electorate voted (currently one 2-year and one 1-year). The district styles its board the Board of Trustees and its members School Trustees (board page and official ballot). Milton School District board page (official): Karen Stout (Chair, 3-year term expires 2027), Jeremy Metcalf (Vice-Chair, 3-year, 2029), Nick DeVita (2-year, 2028), Lindsay Lott (Clerk, 1-year, 2027), Melinda Young (3-year, 2028). The board is styled the Board of Trustees and its members School Trustees.

Town of Milton official March 3, 2026 Town and School Ballot: "FOR SCHOOL TRUSTEE, Three-Year Term: JEREMY METCALF"; "Two-Year Term: NICK DEVITA, ALLISON DUQUETTE"; "One-Year Term: LINDSAY LOTT, FAY PELLETIER." Read against the district roster: Metcalf re-elected (2029), DeVita won the 2-year seat over Duquette (2028), Lott won the 1-year seat (2027). Duquette had held the 2-year seat since 2024.
